package shared

import "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/jobs"

//fabrik:provider
func NewJobStore() (jobs.Store, error) { return jobs.NewMemoryStore(), nil }

type Indexer struct{ S jobs.Store }

//fabrik:inject s name=backup
//fabrik:provider
func NewIndexer(s jobs.Store) *Indexer { return &Indexer{S: s} }
